cli_controls.method: Fresh CLI runs with five warmups and shuffled interleaved samples, serial, warm filesystem, no concurrent builds/tests. Exact byte/status/stderr checks. Native launch counts verified separately with trace. Baseline/candidate inline sources are identical controls. With baseline_uses_identical_program_source=true, baseline_programs and candidate_programs are identical reusable sources; otherwise candidate_programs uses different source with equivalent explicit native/output behavior and typed local scopes. Includes startup, parsing/expansion, validation and execution. Large JSON call arguments use isolated value copies; do not infer an isolated dispatch cost, memory bound, arbitrary-workload speedup or native Linux results.
